speaker: kai_patel
headline: FAILURE IS INEVITABLE. RECOVERY ARCHITECTURE IS A DESIGN CHOICE.
deck: Reliable systems assume incidents will happen and organise detection, isolation, rerouting and verification in advance.
quote: The real test of infrastructure is not whether it never breaks. It is how quickly it can recover without hiding the failure.
facts: Detection must identify the affected state quickly.
Isolation limits the blast radius of an incident.
Rerouting preserves service while repair happens.
Verification confirms that recovery is real rather than cosmetic.
takeaway: Resilience is the capacity to absorb failure, restore service and feed the lesson back into the network.
